tax.text: Latimer opposed the House Republican budget's tax cuts, framing them as giveaways to billionaires paid for by cutting Medicare and food aid.
tax.quote: This plan would hand $7 trillion in tax giveaways to billionaires while cutting Medicare and SNAP benefits for working-and-middle class families

wages.text: Latimer says he will protect workers' right to collectively bargain.
wages.quote: protect the right for workers to collectively bargain

debt.text: Latimer pledges to protect Medicare and Social Security and opposes privatizing them.
debt.quote: protect Medicare and Social Security from being dismantled

housing.text: Latimer favors incentivizing construction of more affordable housing units.
housing.quote: incentivizing the construction of affordable housing units

immigration.text: Latimer supports faster work permits and a path to citizenship for immigrants.
immigration.quote: accelerating work permits for immigrants to contribute to our economy while creating a fair and accessible path to citizenship

guns.text: Latimer backs an assault weapons ban and universal background checks.
guns.quote: advocating for common-sense gun reform including an assault weapons ban

abortion.text: Latimer supports protecting reproductive freedom and opposes a national abortion ban.
abortion.quote: protecting reproductive freedoms and believes it is a vested right

health.text: He voted against the Republican budget, warning its Medicaid cuts would put over 196,000 district residents at risk of losing coverage.
health.quote: The cuts needed for these tax breaks will mean over 196,000 residents in my district are at risk of losing Medicaid coverage.

energy.text: Latimer supports the Green New Deal and shifting from fossil fuels to renewable energy.
energy.quote: investing in renewable energy sources to transition away from fossil fuels

voting.text: Latimer supports expanding voting access through early voting and mail-in ballots.
voting.quote: expanding voting access through initiatives such as early voting, mail-in ballots
